Disclosure.description: A disclosure's open state on the consumer-named page entity; missing state is closed.

open.description: whether the disclosure's content is shown

Order.description: Where an entity dragged over an ordered list (@yaks/ux Order) would land, on the consumer-named page entity; missing state is none dragged over it.

at.description: the index of the row it would land before; the number of rows, after the last

Edit.description: a value being changed where it stands (@yaks/ux Edit), on an entity of its own whose eid is derived from its owner and the value: open while it is, and what its picker searches for; what is typed over it is the person's draft, kept where the host says (its drafts)

open.description: being changed: typed over in place, or its picker floating beside it

query.description: what is typed in its picker's search

Refused.description: an event an Edit emits on the entity whose value it changes: what was typed could not be read as the value's type

caret.description: where the caret stands, as an offset into what is typed

from.description: where the word being completed starts

to.description: where the word being completed ends

cands.description: what can replace the span, each its text and the note shown beside it

pick.description: which of cands is picked, -1 for none: what is typed already reads whole

Completion.description: Completion at a caret, in the host page graph: the replacement span and choices. Text is the host-owned durable draft, not this component.

Signup.description: a sign-up being filled in (@yaks/ux Signup), on the entity derived from its form's door address: the form as the door answered, the answers so far, and how sending went

door.description: the form as its door answered GET: doc, form, open and questions

unread.description: why the form could not be read

answers.description: answers keyed by question id, as registration.answers takes them

tried.description: a send was tried, so required questions still owed say so

sending.description: a send is on its way

sent.description: the door took the answers; the form's thanks show

said.description: why the door refused the answers, in its words

Sort.description: A table's sort choice on its owner-named page entity.
